plants.name: Euphorbia pulcherrima
plants.description: In the wild, this is a tall, rangy shrub or small tree that can reach 3–4 meters. Its branch tips are topped with fiery bracts that look like petals. The real flowers are the tiny yellow-green clusters at the center of each bract rosette. Short winter days trigger the color change.
plants.bloomingSeason: Wild plants bloom in December, in the short days of the Northern Hemisphere winter.
plants.location: Native to Mexico and Central America, where it grows as a wild shrub
plants.funFact: The showy red parts are modified leaves called bracts, not petals. The plant is a short-day plant, so it needs long nights to start coloring up.

plants.name: Ceratopetalum gummiferum
plants.description: This Australian native shrub is covered in small creamy flowers in early summer. As each flower fades, its calyx swells and turns a rich red. The result is a haze of rosy-red, petal-like sepals that glows against dark green leaves, just in time for the holidays.
plants.bloomingSeason: Flowers open from December onwards, in early Southern Hemisphere summer.
plants.location: Eastern Australia, native to New South Wales and grown in gardens including Canberra
plants.funFact: The red color people admire comes from the enlarged calyx, not from the petals. Australians have long cut it as a holiday decoration, which is why it's called Christmas Bush.

plants.name: Delonix regia
plants.description: A broad, umbrella-shaped tree with fern-like leaves. In summer it is covered in masses of orange-scarlet blossoms, each with one petal that is streaked with white and yellow. It is a spectacular sight along warm-climate streets and parks.
plants.bloomingSeason: December to February in Australia's summer.
plants.location: Tropical and subtropical Australia, such as Queensland (the tree is originally from Madagascar)
plants.funFact: After flowering, it produces long, woody, bean-like seed pods. The tree is native to Madagascar, where it is now endangered in the wild, despite being planted in warm regions around the world.
